title: Configuration guard
statement: Let $q$ be a partial configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes, let $interior$ be a Boolean flag, and assign a Boolean value to each configuration port. The guard is true exactly when the state, input-head, and every work-head port are true; the input-symbol port, when $interior$ is true, agrees with the optional input symbol specified by $q$ (and when $interior$ is false, that optional symbol is absent); and, for each work tape, reading its two Boolean work-symbol ports yields the optional symbol specified by $q$.
hypotheses_covered: machine M with k work tapes
